section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1967
title: 3 The variations in incidence of accidental deaths in different regions result from a large number of factors peculiar to the regions such as topography of the area, population, level of industrialisation and other allied factors. Considering population as one of the major concomitant variant, the volume of accidental deaths for one lakh of population was estimated in different States, Union Territories and cities and presented
